copy.anchor: WE does not publish a list of technical controls on this page, and it does not describe a founder's product as secure. It puts security and confidentiality terms in the written agreement. (/trust/)
copy.avoid: A lock, shield, seal, badge, checkmark or certificate (claims C-15, C-24); any security control.

prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of a squared stack of blank white pages held by a plain steel clip, with one clean six-sided hexagon window cut through the top sheet so that the next white sheet shows through. Soft side light. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one small separate six-sided hexagon tile in amber glass resting on the top sheet beside the window. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
